data.summary: The orchestration directory contains Dagster-based pipeline definitions, deployment configs, state management utilities, and execution scripts for managing data workflows.

file_insights.name: Dockerfile
file_insights.summary: Docker file for the Dagster container environment.
file_insights.source_summary: Docker configuration file building a Python 3.11 slim image for Dagster.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the Docker image setup for Dagster webserver and daemon, copying dependencies from uv.lock and setting up the environment.

file_insights.name: dagster.yaml
file_insights.source_summary: YAML configuration for the Dagster instance.
file_insights.detailed_description: Configures the Dagster instance properties such as run coordination, limits, and telemetry settings.

file_insights.name: definitions.py
file_insights.summary: Core Dagster asset definitions and pipeline orchestration logic.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains Dagster assets, partitions, and pipeline definitions for ODS, SCD2, and analytics layers.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the daily Dagster pipeline, assets, checks, resource definitions, and execution flow for data processing.
responsibilities: Implement data quality checks and execution logic

file_insights.name: keys.py
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the final asset constant marking completion of the daily workflow.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores key constants like the final asset name used to track pipeline completion.

file_insights.name: reap.py
file_insights.summary: Startup script to clear orphaned/dead Dagster runs.
file_insights.source_summary: Python script executed at startup to reap dead Dagster runs.
file_insights.detailed_description: Cleans up zombie runs stuck in STARTED or STARTING status upon container startup.
responsibilities: Detect and clear zombie runs upon daemon startup

file_insights.name: state.py
file_insights.summary: Utility script for inspecting Dagster run state and partitions.
file_insights.source_summary: CLI utilities to inspect Dagster instance state, runs, and partitions.
file_insights.detailed_description: Provides read-only querying capabilities into the Dagster instance SQLite database for run status, partitions, and history.
responsibilities: Query run summaries and completed dates

file_insights.name: trigger.py
file_insights.summary: Script to trigger daily pipeline runs with fault injection support.
file_insights.source_summary: Python CLI script to trigger Dagster jobs for specific dates.
file_insights.detailed_description: Triggers the daily Dagster job manually for a specific delivery date, supporting fault injection for testing.
responsibilities: Support synthetic test runs and fault injection
